feat(daemon): journals take turns so click handlers can await (candybar-launch-q7o7.rs0) (#542)

* feat(daemon): journals take turns in one queue, across awaited clicks (candybar-launch-q7o7.rs0)

* fix(daemon): a turn's commits both run, and an evicted idle record is not idle (candybar-launch-q7o7.rs0)

Step 10 fixes. navigation.commit throwing no longer skips the journal commit. inFlight clears at commit, replacing the committed flag, so close never reports a finished click as cut off. Tests now exercise the live gate.

* fix(daemon): an idle close skipped for eviction no longer blames a click (candybar-launch-q7o7.rs0)

* test(daemon): the landing stamp runs on a real verb, even when it throws (candybar-launch-q7o7.rs0)
